commands.description: Start an empty document/compound; all named shapes live here.
Set a session variable usable in later arguments ($var). OCCT ships an expression parser (Expr), not a parametric history.
List session variables.
Set working length unit; OCCT internally works in mm and converts via UnitsAPI.
Set/show the modelling tolerance used by builders.
Give a shape a persistent name (OCAF/XCAF label).
List named shapes, optionally filtered by TopAbs type.
Remove a named shape from the session.
Deep-copy a shape under a new name.

Show boolean/feature modification history (generated/modified/deleted sub-shapes) recorded by BRepAlgoAPI builders for a named shape. RENAMED at integration: bare `history` is the session command log (app layer) — see INTEGRATION-NOTES.md resolution (a).
Undo last document transaction. NOTE: only works for operations recorded as OCAF transactions — the app must wrap commands; raw TopoDS edits have no undo in OCCT.
Redo an undone OCAF transaction.

commands.description: Wedge solid; ltx is top-face x length.

commands.description: Cylinder, optionally a sector by angle.

Torus (donut), optionally partial.
Infinite solid on one side of a face (boolean tool).
Linear sweep of a face along a vector (see also extrude).

commands.args: <face> ax ay az dx dy dz angle
commands.description: Surface/solid of revolution of a face about an axis.
Create a named point.
Create a topological vertex.
Straight segment edge.

commands.args: x y z dx dy dz

commands.description: Full circle edge.

commands.args: cx cy cz R r [nx ny nz]

Hyperbola branch edge.
Parabola edge.

commands.description: Trim a curve to a parameter range.
Offset a curve by a distance in a plane.
Project a curve/point onto a surface, returning the projected edge.

commands.description: Extend a curve by a length with chosen continuity.

commands.occt_class: Parametric cylindrical curve via Geom_Surface (cylinder) + Geom2d_Line diagonal + BRepBuilderAPI_MakeEdge
commands.description: True helix edge: a diagonal 2D line on a cylindrical surface mapped to 3D. OCCT has no single MakeHelix primitive class — this is the documented construction route, and thread/screw sweeps build on it.
Planar/ conical spiral approximated by an interpolated B-spline — labelled approximation, not an analytic OCCT curve type.
Report arc length of an edge/curve.
Evaluate a point (and optionally tangent) on a curve.
Report curvature/radius at a parameter.

commands.args: x y z [nx ny nz] [w h]
commands.description: Planar face, optionally bounded.
Cylindrical surface face.
Conical surface face.
Spherical surface face.
Toroidal surface face.

commands.args: <edge> ax ay az dx dy dz
commands.description: Surface made by revolving a curve.
Surface made by extruding a curve along a direction.
Bezier patch from a control net.
B-spline surface from control net or interpolated through a point grid.
Fill an n-sided hole bounded by edges (Plate/Filling). The CAD 'patch a hole' operation.
commands.example: fill-surface e1 e2 e3 e4 style coons as patch

commands.description: Plate surface passing through curve/point constraints with G1/G2 continuity targets.
Offset surface/sheet by a distance.
Evaluate point, normal, curvature on a surface.
Find UV parameters of the projection of a 3D point.

commands.occt_class: GeomFill / BRepFill ruled via GeomAPI? GeomFill_BSplineCurves style ruled
commands.description: Ruled (straight-line) surface between two curves.
Join connected edges into a wire; reports gaps if ends do not meet within tolerance.
commands.example: wire e1 e2 e3 e4 as prof1

commands.args: x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 ... [close]
commands.description: Polyline wire from points, optionally closed.

commands.args: <wire> [plane x y z nx ny nz]
commands.description: Planar (or surface-bounded) face from a closed wire.
Face with inner wires as holes.
commands.example: face-with-holes outer hole inner1 as plate_face

commands.occt_class: BRepBuilderAPI_MakePolygon + MakeFace (app profile builder over OCCT)
commands.description: Rectangle profile face — convenience profile built from OCCT edges, not a separate OCCT class.
Circular profile face.

commands.occt_class: Two GC_MakeArcOfCircle + two GC_MakeSegment in a MakeWire
commands.description: Oblong/slot profile face (convenience profile).

commands.occt_class: BRepBuilderAPI_MakeFace plane + app sketch record of OCCT edges
commands.description: Start a named 2D profile on a plane/face. IMPORTANT: OCCT has NO parametric sketch constraint solver (see Limitations) — a 'sketch' here is a set of exact OCCT edges/wires on a plane, with numeric coordinates, not driven dimensions.
Add a line to the open sketch.

commands.args: x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3
commands.description: Add an arc through 3 sketch points.
Add a circle to the open sketch.
Add an interpolated spline to the open sketch.
Close the sketch into wire(s)+face; reports open ends / self-intersections found by BRepCheck.
Report wire order, closure, self-intersection, small edges.
Reorder/reconnect a wire's edges into a traversable order.

commands.args: <face|wire> dx dy dz | along <dir> distance <d> [taper deg]
commands.occt_class: BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism (taper: BRepFeat? / BRepOffsetAPI taper via MakePrism + Draft)
commands.description: Extrude a profile face along a direction — the core pad operation.
commands.example: extrude prof1 along 0 0 1 distance 12 as pad

commands.description: Extrude equally both ways from the profile plane.
Extrude a profile until it meets a target face — a local feature operation, not a plain prism.
commands.example: extrude-to-face prof1 to topface as boss

commands.args: <face|wire> ax ay az dx dy dz angle
commands.description: Revolve a profile about an axis by an angle (360 = full).
Loft through a series of section wires; ruled = straight between sections, otherwise smooth.
commands.example: loft w1 w2 w3 solid as body1

commands.description: Sweep a profile along a path with a trihedron mode.
commands.example: sweep prof along path as rail

commands.description: Constant-section pipe along a spine.
commands.example: pipe prof along path as tube

commands.description: Full sweep control: mode and corner transition.
commands.example: pipe-shell prof along path mode frenet transition round as duct

commands.occt_class: BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell with auxiliary spine / law functions (GeomFill with sections)
commands.description: Sweep whose section changes along the path (PipeShell with multiple sections / laws).
commands.example: variable-sweep path sections s@0 s@0.5 s@1 as duct

commands.description: Sweep a profile along a helix — screw threads, coils, springs (profile should be the thread tooth for threads).
commands.example: helix-sweep tooth r 10 pitch 5 height 40 as thread

commands.description: Swept surface between two guide curves (BRepFill).

commands.args: <face> ax ay az dx dy dz angle
commands.occt_class: BRepFeat_MakeRevol (revolved local feature in cut mode — OCCT has no separate MakeGroove class in 8.0.1; verified against the TKFeat package list)
commands.description: Revolved cut feature (a turned groove) from a profile face.

commands.args: <solid> face <face> centre x y r depth <d>|through
commands.description: Drill a cylindrical hole as a local feature into a solid from a face (BRepFeat cylindrical-hole feature, with its own status/error reporting).
commands.example: hole-feature body1 face topface centre 20 15 r 3 depth through as body1

commands.description: Rib/slot feature grown from a profile until it meets the base solid.
Drafted prism feature (prism with draft angle) fused/cut as a local operation.
Linear (extruded-with-rules) feature form (rib/slot family).
Glue a feature shape onto a solid at a face (local operation keeping the rest untouched).
commands.example: glued-feature boss on body1 glue topface as body2

commands.description: Split a shape by a tool face, keeping local-operation history.
commands.example: split-feature body1 by midplane as body1

commands.description: Boolean union. glue = faster glued option for touching solids; fuzzy adds tolerance.
Boolean subtraction (a − b). Multiple tools allowed.
Boolean intersection — the volume shared by both.
Edges where two shapes' surfaces intersect (no solid result).
Split a by b, keeping all resulting pieces (splitter, unlike cut/fuse).
commands.example: split body1 by plane1 as pieces

commands.occt_class: BOPAlgo_Builder + BRepAlgoAPI_BuilderAlgo (general boolean with argument/tool sets — there is no BRepAlgoAPI_MultiFuse class in OCCT 8.0.1; verified)
commands.description: General Boolean Operation (GBO) with separate argument and tool lists, non-destructive/fuzzy/glue options.
commands.example: boolean-multi fuse base tools t1 t2 as body1

commands.description: Show/set global boolean options: fuzzy tolerance, glue, parallel, OBB pre-check, inverted-solid checking.
Remove selected faces (holes, fillets, pockets) and heal the surrounding solid closed — OCCT's defeaturing, built on the boolean engine.
commands.example: defeature body1 remove faces face(12) face(13) as clean

commands.description: Cut a solid with the half-space beyond a face.
Constant-radius rolling-ball fillet on selected edges (or all).
commands.example: fillet body1 radius 2 on edges edge(3) edge(4) as body1

commands.args: <shape> on edge <e> radius <r1> at start radius <r2> at end
commands.description: Variable-radius fillet along an edge.
commands.example: fillet-variable body1 on edge edge(3) radius 1 at start radius 4 at end as body1

commands.description: Fillet radius driven by a law function along the edge.
commands.example: fillet-law body1 on edge edge(3) law 1 3 1 as body1

commands.description: Chamfer: equal distances, two distances, or distance+angle.
commands.example: chamfer body1 distance 1.5 on edges all as body1

commands.description: 2D fillet/chamfer between planar edges in a profile (before extrusion).
2D corner fillet inside a planar wire.
commands.example: fillet-2d prof1 radius 3 at vertex 2 as prof1

commands.description: Hollow a solid to a wall thickness, opening the listed faces.
commands.example: shell body1 thickness 2 remove faces topface as housing

commands.description: Give a surface/sheet solid thickness.
Offset a whole solid/sheet in/out by a distance (grow/shrink).
commands.example: offset-shape body1 distance -0.4 mode skin join arc as body1

commands.occt_class: BRepOffsetAPI_MakeOffset (face offset in a wire/face context)
commands.description: Offset a face/wire in its plane (2D offset for profiles).

commands.args: <shape> angle <deg> neutral <face|plane> dir x y z [add faces ...]
commands.description: Apply mould draft taper to selected faces about a neutral plane.
commands.example: draft body1 angle 3 neutral bottom dir 0 0 1 as body1

commands.occt_class: BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle analysis via face normals (GeomLProp) — app analysis over OCCT normals
commands.description: Report faces under the minimum draft angle for a pull direction (mouldability check). Analysis only; no geometry change.
Convenience chain: sew/heal a sheet then thicken (app script of two OCCT ops).
Move a shape (in place unless copy).

commands.args: <shape> ax ay az dx dy dz angle [copy]
commands.description: Rotate about an arbitrary axis.

commands.occt_class: gp_Trsf SetScale + BRepBuilderAPI_Transform (true geometry scale: BRepBuilderAPI_GTransform)
commands.description: Uniform scale. NOTE: non-uniform scale needs gtransform (below) and converts surfaces to B-splines in places.
commands.example: scale body1 factor 2 centre 0 0 0 copy as big

commands.description: General (incl. non-uniform) transform; may downgrade analytic surfaces — reported honestly in output.

commands.args: <shape> plane x y z nx ny nz [copy]
commands.description: Mirror about a plane.
commands.example: mirror body1 plane 0 0 0 1 0 0 copy as otherhalf

commands.description: Set a shape's location (placement) without rebuilding geometry — cheap, reversible.
Report a shape's placement (translation + rotation).

commands.args: <shape|feature> dir x y z count <n> spacing <d> [fuse]
commands.occt_class: gp_Trsf repeated + BRepAlgoAPI_MultiFuse (app loop over OCCT transforms/booleans)
commands.description: Repeat a shape/feature in a line. OCCT has no single pattern class — this is an app loop over transforms (+ optional fuse), stated as such.
commands.example: linear-pattern hole1 dir 1 0 0 count 5 spacing 12 fuse as body1

commands.description: Repeat around an axis (same app-loop note as linear-pattern).
commands.example: polar-pattern tooth axis 0 0 0 0 0 1 count 12 angle 360 fuse as gear

commands.args: <shape> dir1 ... n1 spacing1 dir2 ... n2 spacing2 [fuse]
commands.description: 2D grid pattern (app loop, as above).
commands.example: rect-pattern hole1 dir1 1 0 0 n1 4 spacing1 10 dir2 0 1 0 n2 3 spacing2 10 fuse

commands.description: Mirror and fuse to the original (symmetric part completion).
commands.example: mirror-pattern half plane 0 0 0 1 0 0 fuse as whole

commands.description: Apply a list of transforms producing multiple copies (instancing by copy).
commands.example: copy-transform bolt transforms placements.csv as bolts

commands.description: Full census: solids/shells/faces/wires/edges/vertices, closed?, orientation, location.
Report TopAbs type (SOLID, SHELL, FACE, ...).
List/count solids inside a shape, naming them solid(1)... for later commands.
List faces, optionally only one surface type — the selection vocabulary for fillet/shell/etc.
List edges by curve type.
List wires.
List vertices with coordinates.
List shells and whether each is closed.

Is a point IN, ON, or OUT of a solid?

commands.description: Angle between planes/cylinders' axes or edge tangents.

Perimeter length of a face/wire.

commands.description: Section edges at a plane; with area, the section face area and centroid.

Mass from true OCCT volume and a user density — arithmetic, not a material database (OCCT has none built in).

commands.description: Set sub-shape tolerances (last-resort repair; loosening tolerance can hide real errors — output warns).

Export STL, tessellating first with the given deflection.

Show XCAF assembly tree: labels, names, instances, locations.
List XCAF colours per label/face (surface, curve, generic).
List XCAF materials / visual materials (PBR parameters stored in the file).

Triangulate a shape's faces (the mesh the viewer and mesh exports use). Reports triangle count.

commands.occt_class: Poly_Triangulation checks / BRepCheck on triangulation (app checks over Poly data)
commands.description: Check stored mesh for degenerate triangles / free mesh edges.
Hidden-line-removal projection: visible/hidden sharp & smooth edges as 2D/3D edges — the technical-drawing edge set.
Export HLR result (drawing linework) as shapes.
Set BRep/XCAF surface colour on a shape or face. Without an XCAF document this is document metadata, not geometry.

commands.description: Set transparency as XCAF visual material data.

commands.occt_class: XCAFDoc_ColorTool::GetColor per face (as in cascade-port mc_shape_face_colors)
commands.description: Report per-face colours carried by an imported XDE file.

Interference report: do the solids overlap, and by what volume (common > 0)? Distinct from measure-distance (=0 when touching/overlapping).
Pass/fail clearance check against a minimum gap.

integration_notes: history renamed to shape-history (integration resolution a); bare `history` = session command log, app layer. Export canonical forms are export-step/export-iges/... (resolution b); compact prototype forms are aliases.
